summary.zh: 新增「记忆梦境」：助手会在后台自动整理长期记忆，设置里可以查看每次整理的版本并对比变化；聊天渲染管线重构为单通道语义流，长会话更流畅、显示更准确；归档对话恢复显示真实标题，并支持手动勾选批量删除。
summary.en: Introducing Memory Dream: your assistant now consolidates long-term memory in the background, with revision history and diffs in settings; the chat rendering pipeline was rebuilt around a single semantic channel for smoother, more accurate long conversations; archived chats show their real titles again and can be bulk-deleted by manual selection.

title.zh: 记忆梦境：后台自动整理长期记忆
title.en: Memory Dream: background long-term memory consolidation

summary.zh: 助手现在会在后台像做梦一样自动整理长期记忆，把零散的印象合并成清晰的要点；设置中新增记忆梦境控制项与版本浏览器，可查看每次整理的版本并对比与当前记忆的变化。
summary.en: Your assistant now consolidates long-term memory in the background, merging scattered impressions into clear facts. Settings gain Memory Dream controls and a revision browser where you can review each consolidation and diff it against current memory.

details.zh: 每个助手拥有独立的梦境整理核心，并与灵犀记忆槽位打通。
details.en: Each agent gets its own Dream consolidation core, integrated with the Lingxi memory slot.

details.zh: 版本浏览器支持查看当前记忆与任一历史版本的差异对比。
details.en: The revision browser can diff current memory against any historical revision.

sources.title: feat(memory): add per-agent Memory Dream core
feat(settings): add Memory Dream controls and revision browser

title.zh: 聊天渲染管线重构：长会话更流畅
title.en: Chat rendering pipeline rebuild: smoother long conversations

summary.zh: 聊天渲染链路重构为单通道语义流，解析前移、消息语义归一化，长会话渲染更流畅、内容显示更准确。
summary.en: The chat rendering pipeline was rebuilt around a single semantic channel with front-loaded parsing and normalized message semantics, making long conversations render smoother and more accurately.

details.zh: 流式更新按语义发布，Markdown 从增量源渲染，避免重复解析整段历史。
details.en: Stream updates publish by semantics and markdown renders from an incremental source, avoiding re-parsing the whole history.

details.zh: 重型历史渲染延后执行，滚动与加载大量消息时明显更顺滑。
details.en: Heavy history rendering is deferred, noticeably smoothing scrolling and loading of large message lists.

sources.title: feat(chat): consolidate semantics pipeline with canonical single channel

title.zh: 归档对话恢复真实标题，支持勾选批量删除
title.en: Archived chats show real titles again, with selectable bulk delete

summary.zh: 修复归档页面中对话标题全部显示为「新对话」的问题，现在会回退显示对话的首条消息作为标题；归档管理新增勾选框，可手动多选并批量删除，不再只有 30 天/90 天清理。
summary.en: Fixed archived chats all showing as “New chat” — titles now fall back to each conversation's first message. Archive management gains checkboxes for manual multi-select bulk deletion, beyond the 30/90-day cleanup options.

details.zh: 标题回退链路与主侧边栏一致：自定义标题优先，其次首条消息。
details.en: The title fallback chain matches the main sidebar: custom title first, then first message.

sources.title: fix(archive): restore archived chat titles and add manual bulk delete

title.zh: 供应商能力模型与语音/媒体配置界面
title.en: Provider capability metadata and speech/media config UI

summary.zh: 统一了模型能力元数据，按用途匹配兼容性；设置中新增语音识别与媒体能力配置界面，媒体/模型配置围绕注册表能力绑定重建。
summary.en: Model capability metadata is unified with purpose-scoped compatibility; settings gain speech recognition and media capability configuration, rebuilt around registry capability bindings.

sources.title: feat(providers): unify model capability metadata & purpose-scoped compat
feat(media&providers): add speech recognition & media capabilities config UI

title.zh: 人格配置迁移到 AGENTS.md 并兼容旧格式
title.en: Persona contract migrated to AGENTS.md with legacy compatibility

summary.zh: 助手人格契约迁移到 AGENTS.md 格式，并在迁移失败时保留旧人格配置，避免人格丢失；同时修复了人格工作区重复注入的问题。
summary.en: The agent persona contract migrated to AGENTS.md, preserving legacy persona on failed migration so no persona is lost; also fixed duplicate persona workspace injection.

sources.title: feat(agent): migrate persona contract to AGENTS.md
fix(persona): preserve legacy persona on failed AGENTS migration

title.zh: 自动化任务存储更健壮

summary.zh: 自动化任务的本地存储损坏时现在可以安全恢复，持久化失败也会在界面中明确提示，不再静默丢失任务。
summary.en: Corrupt automation storage now recovers safely, and persistent store failures are surfaced in the UI instead of silently losing tasks.

sources.title: fix(automation): recover corrupt automation storage safely
fix(automation): surface persistent store failures in UI

title.zh: 修复编辑器中裸链接的 Markdown 渲染
title.en: Fix bare markdown URLs in the editor

summary.zh: 修复了编辑器中未包裹的裸 URL 在 Markdown 渲染时被破坏的问题。
summary.en: Fixed an issue where bare, unwrapped URLs were mangled by markdown rendering in the editor.

title.zh: 清理 Windows 上过期的内置种子数据
title.en: Remove stale installed seed payloads on Windows

summary.zh: 修复了 Windows 上旧版本残留的内置种子数据未被清理的问题，避免过期内容干扰新版本。
summary.en: Fixed stale built-in seed payloads from older versions lingering on Windows, preventing outdated content from interfering with new versions.

sources.title: fix(windows): remove stale installed seed payloads
